threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'London Fields' is a park rather than a local vibe, and you're bewildered by the brunch queues that start before 10am.
Saw a guy on the N21 last night trying to barter his old vinyl records for a ticket. The driver just shook his head and kept driving.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of freshly baked pastries at the corner bakery and the sound of mixed languages in the park—it hits different on a sunny Saturday.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find an abandoned amusement park like Spreepark turned into a playground for urban explorers and a backdrop for film shoots. Total surrealism.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Real locals know to avoid Civic Center BART when something goes boom. Tourists just stare at the chaos, frozen like deer in headlights.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy with a dog in a sweater calmly reading a novel on the 14 Mission. Only in San Francisco do we ride the bus like it’s a café.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think all bars are full till dawn, but locals know the best vibe is at 10 PM, when the tapers are fresh and conversations are real.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll know a recent arrival by their hesitation at the metro ticket machines; they’re still sifting through the options like it’s a Rubik's cube.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus without checking Citymapper first, as if that 243 might just magically appear. Bless your heart.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with old soul tracks. Everyone pretended to be asleep, but I saw at least three people tapping along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a kid argue passionately with their mom in Turkish about which döner shop is the best on my street.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a techno party that starts at 6 AM and ends at sunset, all while your neighbors cheer from their balconies.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they instinctively check BART delays before deciding if it's worth getting a burrito at La Taqueria. The weight of the commute is real.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of a mom juggling a stroller while reassuring her toddler on a packed 38. Just a Tuesday in the 'loin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's just about the plaça and bars, but many miss the quiet charm of its hidden gardens and the locals tending their community veggie patches.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still stop to take photos of the street performers in Plaça del Sol, clueless that they've been there since before the pandemic.
